description: This file defines the TensorHandle type and associated methods for managing tensor data on devices within the TensorFlow Go API. It includes functions for creating, copying, and retrieving properties of tensor handles, which are references to tensors potentially on different devices.

classes.name: TensorHandle
classes.description: A handle to a tensor on a device, supporting various operations to access tensor properties and manage device placement.

methods.name: NewTensorHandle
methods.description: Creates a new tensor handle from a Tensor.

methods.name: Shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the tensor referenced by the handle.

methods.name: DataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the tensor handle.

methods.name: DeviceName
methods.description: Returns the device name where the tensor was produced.

methods.name: BackingDeviceName
methods.description: Returns the device name in whose memory the tensor handle resides.

methods.name: ToTensor
methods.description: Returns the actual Tensor referenced by the handle, potentially blocking until computed.

methods.name: CopyToDevice
methods.description: Creates a new tensor handle for the same tensor, placed on a specified device.
